page.overview:
What is Slaughter of the Ascendant?

Centuries before 4 ABY Bar'leth that housed the Spark Eternal, a sentient piece of technology created by the Ascendant that granted the user enormous power for the price of their life. The Sith sought the Spark Eternal, but an Ascendant cultist named Miril used the Spark to telekinetically stab many of the Sith with their own lightsabers. However Miril was still overcome by them, and gave her life to seal the Spark Eternal away and prevent the Sith from retrieving it. and were all killed by the Sith.

Sometime between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra discovered the Spark Eternal and was possessed by it, which allowed her to reach into the Spark's memories to see and learn about the slaughter and defeat of the Ascendant.

Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy
